options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: command
options.description: The command to run. Use full file paths for this command and include an command parameters.

options.name: hour
options.description: The hour(s) at which the command will be executed. (0-23, ranges, or divided, *=all)

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: mday
options.description: The day(s) of the month on which the command will be executed. (1-31, ranges, or divided, *=all).

options.name: minute
options.description: The minute(s) at which the command will be executed or a special @ event string. (0-59, ranges, divided, @ event or delay, *=all). When using a special @ event, such as @reboot, the other time fields must be empty.

options.name: month
options.description: The month(s) of the year in which the command will be executed. (1-31, ranges, or divided, *=all).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: wday
options.description: The day(s) of the week on which the command will be executed. (0-7, 7=Sun or use names, ranges, or divided, *=all).

options.name: who
options.description: The OS user to use when cron runs the command.
